installCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm install --include=dev --prefix backend; else npm install --include=dev --prefix ../frontend && npm install --include=dev; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm run build --prefix frontend; else npm run build --prefix ../frontend && mkdir -p frontend && cp -R ../frontend/dist frontend/dist; fi
